story_scene: Level 57 (story-only, winfail075 -> 57,57; its own 960x704 shape41\level57.SHP hall): the dying
塔克斯 054 apologises to 克羅蒂 and envies 雷歐納德's freedom, then vanishes (actDeleteObject); the
script opens the storage window, keeps the party's ST and hands over with
actSetNextPlayLevelGetOverEvent 0 — the finals 76 / 77 / 78 chosen by the over-score dispatch
EndingDispatchRules picks from the campaign's over_score / over_flag, beside the plain return.
The three finals the handler can return (0x42c520: gameoverID1 -> 76 妖精王 with no
over flag, gameoverID2 -> 77 席德爾 with gameoverflagFreeEnemy, gameoverID3 -> 78 接觸
with gameoverflagEnemyJobUp; default 76). The pair is (level, level) because the
script passes level 0. The runtime picks the row from the world state.
